summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Lowkey Home page redesign with 7 sections. All backend APIs working (11/11 tests passed). All 7 sections verified in correct order with proper UI elements. Login flow works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Recent Activity section uses MOCKED data - activity signals (viewed profile, liked, online) are simulated from real member data, not from actual user activity tracking
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data - 7 lounges and founder account
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Home page redesign features verified working. The 7 sections are in correct order: 1) Discover/Connections (profile cards in 2-column grid with See all button), 2) Active Now (stories + online members horizontal scroll with Add Story button), 3) Recent Activity (activity signals - MOCKED), 4) Featured Lounge (After Dark with LIVE indicator and Enter CTA), 5) Lounges (real existing lounges in simple list), 6) Monetisation (Credits and Exclusive/Unlock buttons), 7) Radio (link to /radio). Bottom navigation has Home/Lounge/After Dark/Profile tabs. Header has credit balance (0), Verified badge, notification bell, and settings.

login_flow.details: Login with kinglowkey@hotmail.com / password123 works correctly. Onboarding modal appears on first login and can be dismissed.

section_1_discover.details: Discover section exists at top with 6 profile cards in 2-column grid. 'See all' button navigates to /search. Profile cards link to /search?view={userId}.

section_1_connection_requests.details: Connection requests section is conditional - only shows when there are pending friend requests. Currently hidden (no pending requests).

section_2_active_now.details: Active Now section shows stories + online member avatars in horizontal scroll. Add Story button present and opens story modal with Photo/Video/Text tabs and Share Story button.

section_3_recent_activity.details: Recent Activity section shows 4 activity signals (viewed profile, is now online, liked your profile, sent a connection request). NOTE: This data is MOCKED/simulated from real member names.

section_4_featured_lounge.details: Featured Lounge section shows After Dark with 'LIVE' indicator, description 'Private. Discreet. For those who want more.', and 'Enter' CTA button.

section_5_lounges.details: Lounges section shows 5 real existing lounges (Night Owls, Chill Vibes Only, Music Lovers, etc.) in simple list format with colored accent bars. 'All' button present.

section_6_monetisation.details: Monetisation section has Credits button (shows credit count 0) and Exclusive/Unlock button. Credits button navigates to /wallet.

section_7_radio.details: Radio section has Radio button with correct text 'Radio' and 'Listen while you browse'. Button navigates to /radio.

bottom_navigation.details: Bottom navigation has 4 tabs: Home (purple active), Lounge, After Dark, Profile. All tabs are clickable.

header_credit_balance.details: Credit balance button in header shows wallet icon with credit count (0).

header_verified_badge.details: Verified badge visible in header for founder account.

api_auth_login.details: POST /api/auth/login returns 200 with user object and token. Uses 'identifier' field for email/displayName.

api_users.details: GET /api/users returns 200 with list of users for Discover section.

api_lounges.details: GET /api/lounges returns 200 with list of 7 lounges including Night Owls, Chill Vibes Only, Music Lovers.

api_stories.details: GET /api/stories returns 200 with story groups for Active Now section.

api_friend_requests.details: GET /api/friends/requests/{userId} returns 200 with pending and sent requests.

mocked_data.recent_activity: Recent Activity section has simulated activity signals using real member names but mock actions (viewed profile, liked, online). This is expected per requirements.

visual_verification.discover_section: 2-column grid with profile cards showing user initials, gradient backgrounds, green online dots, display names, and 'Online now' status
visual_verification.active_now: Horizontal scroll with Add Story button (dashed border, + icon), story circles with gradient borders, and online member avatars with green dots
visual_verification.recent_activity: Activity feed with colored icons (blue eye, green users, pink heart, gold user-plus) and timestamps
visual_verification.featured_lounge: Dark card with After Dark title, LIVE indicator (gold dot + text), description, member count, and Enter CTA button
visual_verification.lounges_list: Simple list format with colored accent bars (blue, green, gold, purple, pink), lounge names, and chevron icons
visual_verification.monetisation: Two buttons side by side - Credits (gold wallet icon, credit count) and Exclusive (red lock icon, 'Unlock content')
visual_verification.radio: Card with red radio icon, 'Radio' title, 'Listen while you browse' subtitle, and chevron
visual_verification.bottom_nav: 4 tabs with Home having purple active state, others in muted white
